answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and only 14 days to contract expiry, continuity has high operational value. The current intent is to negotiate an incumbent renewal that targets the mandated spend reduction through market benchmarking, pricing, and payment/term structure, while preserving delivery performance. Verification should confirm whether prior negotiation and multi-year pricing results are applicable enough to support the required savings without creating a supply interruption.
